Tiggala_Bhaṭṭa
or Tigalā or Tyāgalāla, resident of Śrīsthala in Gujarat; father of Maljit Vedāṅgarāya, patronised by Shah Jehan; (a. of Pārasīprakāśa or Sanskrit Pārasī Bhāṣāracanā; Mahārudrapaddhati. Mithilā IV. 124. etc.). [Page166-a.
See Cultural His.. of Gujarat p. 314.
--Śrīsthalaprakāśa. BORI. 154 of 1892-95. Peters. V. p. 235 (no. 154).
